Help.title: Workspace guide
Help.subtitle: A quick guide to this local Cognacta preview.
Help.chatsBody: Start a chat from the sidebar. Use its menu to rename, move, archive, or delete it. Create and manage projects from the plus beside Projects.
Help.contextBody: Use the composer’s plus menu to attach files or select knowledge sources. Sources are saved as snapshots with your message. File contents are not uploaded or saved after a reload; only their names are retained.
Help.restoreBody: Archived chats keep their messages. Open the archive and choose Restore from a chat’s menu. Deletion is permanent.
Help.simulatedBody: Assistant replies, models, skills, and app connections are demonstrations. No model API, authentication, billing, web search, or file upload service is connected. Personalization is stored locally but does not alter the demo responses.
Help.privacyBody: Your workspace stays in this browser’s local storage. It is not encrypted or synchronized across devices. Clearing site data removes local work. Avoid sensitive information in this preview.

replies.one: I’ve got it. I’d start by clarifying the outcome, then group the work into the smallest useful decisions. Here’s a focused first pass.
replies.two: There’s a clear thread here. I can turn this into a concise plan, identify the open questions, and draft the first deliverable.
replies.three: Let’s make this concrete. I’ll separate what we know, what needs a decision, and the next action that moves the work forward.

Demo.assistantIntro: I pulled the relevant context into one place. We can continue from the open decision or revise the direction.

brandVoice.title: Brand voice & writing guidelines
brandVoice.content: Write like a helpful teammate. Be direct, use plain language, and lead with the outcome. Keep interface labels short and specific.

projectBrief.title: Website launch brief
projectBrief.content: Build a clear homepage that explains the product, shows how it works, and helps visitors take the next step. Prioritize mobile layouts and accessible controls.
